## Checklist

- [ ] Behaviour change includes tests (TDD once Go code exists)
- [ ] Docs / ADR / openspec updated when the change is decision- or contract-affecting
- [ ] No secrets or real connection credentials in fixtures, examples, or logs
- [ ] Commits follow `:gitmoji: type(scope): summary`, one logical change each, DCO signed-off
- [ ] Branch rebases cleanly onto `main`
